A [[Color/Legends|blue]]-hued '''planet''' was located near the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], not far from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. A stormy world, the planet appeared to be blue in color from [[Realspace/Legends|space]], while its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] had white and gray clouds. It had five moons and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Silver/Legends|silver]]-scaled [[draigon]].
